entries.title: Prints charming: biometric security reaches the billions
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that the active base of fingerprint reader-equipped devices will top one billion for the first time in early 2017.
entries.subject: Biometric authentication

entries.title: DDoS attacks enter the terabit era
entries.quote: Deloitte Global expects there will be on average a Tbit/s (terabit per second) attack per month, over 10 million attacks in total, and an average attack size of between 1.25 and 1.5 Gbit/s
entries.subject: DDoS attacks

entries.title: Safety first: the road to self-driving starts with a stop
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that by 2022, annual US motor vehicle fatalities could fall by 6,000, a 16 percent decline on the likely death toll in 2017.
entries.metric: reduction in annual US motor vehicle fatalities
entries.subject: Automatic emergency braking and road safety

entries.title: 5G: a revolution in evolution, even in 2017
entries.quote: by end-2017, over 200 carriers are likely to be offering LTE-A across some of their network, and over 20 should have LTE-A Pro networks.
entries.subject: 5G and LTE-Advanced

entries.title: Brains at the edge: machine learning goes mobile
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that over 300 million smartphones, or more than a fifth of units sold in 2017, will have on-board neural network machine learning capability.
entries.metric: smartphones sold with on-device neural network capability
entries.subject: On-device machine learning

entries.title: The great indoors: the final frontier for digital navigation
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that as of 2022 at least a quarter of all human and machine uses of precision digital navigation will include an indoor leg or be for an entirely indoor journey.
entries.metric: share of precision navigation uses with an indoor leg
entries.subject: Indoor navigation

entries.title: TV advertising in the US: flat is the new up
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that US TV advertising revenue in 2017 will be flat with 2016.
entries.subject: TV advertising

entries.title: Have we reached peak tablet?
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that 2017 sales of tablet computers ('tablets') will be fewer than 165 million units, down by about 10 percent from the 182 million units sold in 2016.
entries.subject: Tablets

entries.title: Vinyl: the billion-dollar nostalgic niche
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that vinyl will continue its remarkable resurgence ... [and] may generate approaching $1 billion globally in revenues for the first time this millennium.
entries.subject: Vinyl records

entries.title: IT-as-a-Service: the half trillion dollar 'niche'
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that by the end of 2018, spending on IT-as-a-Service ... for data centers, software and services will be just under $550 billion worldwide.
entries.subject: IT-as-a-Service

notes: 16th edition by count from 2002. From 2017 the report is no longer split into Technology / Media / Telecommunications sections (section is null). Rank is the order in the report. Publication month from the January launch pattern.
